messages:
oncall-bot: Paging @ashley: elevated 5xx + 429 rate on /v1/embeddings across us-west-2. Error spike started ~2854321500. Auto-alert triggered and customers:heavy_impact tag applied.
ashley: ack I'm on it. seeing latency spikes and queued batches backing up. taking lead.
mohit: I can help with traffic shaping. quick question — are chat or rerank affected?
ashley: chat endpoints look normal (p50/p95 steady). rerank shows a few 429s but much fewer than embeddings. looks like a hotpath in the embeddings model serving layer.
carla: any single customer spiking? topk shows a single client sending large multi-k request flood (batch_size=1024) from a legacy integration.
kevin: flagging that legacy-integration has been doing hourly bulk embed jobs since rollout. we should throttle that client first.
ashley: plan: 1) tighten per-endpoint quotas for embeddings to protect global throughput; 2) add route-specific limits for legacy-integration; 3) temporarily disable rerank on non-critical routes if things still degrade. doing canary changes to one node first.
mohit: ok. make the per-endpoint rule conservative — reduce embeddings rps by 60% and cap bulk_batch_size to 128. apply route limit to legacy-integration: 5 rps, max_batch 128.
ashley: applying quota update for embeddings (canary):
```bash
# canary to node group embed-east-1-canary
redwoodctl quota update --route "/v1/embeddings" --rps 20 --burst 40 --max-batch 128 --selector embed-east-1-canary
```
ashley: also pushing route rule:
```yaml
routes:
  - name: legacy-integration
    path_prefix: "/v1/embeddings"
    selectors: [client_id:legacy-integration]
    limits:
      rps: 5
      max_batch: 128
```
deploy-bot: quota update accepted; rolling to embed-east-1-canary (job 7892). ETA 45s. :gear:
ashley: canary applied to 3 nodes. monitoring logs.
carla: support: draft customer message? legacy-integration will see degraded throughput. recommend telling them to switch to batched smaller requests.
support-team: drafting message and pre-approved mitigation steps. will post to account channel if the rule is enforced cluster-wide.
mohit: telemetry after canary: p50 embeddings latency down 20%, 429 rate on canary nodes dropped from 12% -> 1.8%. good signal.
ashley: rolling to all embed nodes with slightly higher rps to avoid starving normal traffic: rps 30, burst 60, max_batch 128.
kevin: also enabling soft-throttle on rerank for non-paying tiers: set rerank rps to 2 for free tier.
ashley: applying rerank soft-throttle: `redwoodctl quota update --route "/v1/rerank" --tier free --rps 2`
deploy-bot: rerank throttle applied.
ashley: immediate outcome: global 5xxs reduced 85%, embeddings 429s dropped 78% overall. some customers (legacy-integration) reporting timeouts — support has the prepared message.
carla: filing followup: add customer-facing guidance to migration docs about batch sizing and backoff.
mohit: action items: (a) postmortem if recurrence, (b) consider adaptive per-client scoring to auto-throttle heavy batchers, (c) add a monitoring rule to alert when single client >30% of embeddings QPS.
ashley: handing off to @kevin for night oncall in 30m. I will update the incident channel with a short summary and create an incident ticket for root-cause investigation.
kevin: taking handoff. I have runbooks and will watch the throttles overnight. ping me if any regression.
support-team: notified affected accounts; CS will open support tickets for impacted customers.
ashley: closing thread for live mitigations — finally notes: adjusted embeddings quotas and route limits, rerank soft-throttle, legacy-integration restricted, followups assigned.
on-message-log: Reaction summary — :thumbsup: on deploys, :eyes: on canary metrics.
